title: Niagara Falls Canada Guided Walking Tour With Boat Cruise
includes: Scenic walk along Niagara Parkway with stunning viewpoints
Pre-reserved Niagara City Cruise Boat Ride ticket
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Schedule Flexibility – We do our best to keep to schedule, but times may vary due to traffic, weather, or other unexpected delays.
This experience has a walking tour. Guests should be able to walk at a moderate pace without difficulty.
The tour meeting time is 10 minutes prior to the start time. No refunds can be provided for late arrivals or no-shows.
Tours run rain or shine. We encourage appropriate footwear for uneven surfaces.
Ponchos are available on City Cruises Boat. You will get close to the waterfall. Be prepared to get wet

Parking is limited in Niagara Falls and lots often fill up by mid day. We suggest taking an Uber or Taxi to the meeting point. However, there are a number of paid parking lots in the area, the closest being on Hiram Street
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: See Niagara Falls from two perspectives on this tour, which combines a guided walking tour with a boat cruise. Meet your guide at Casino Niagara 5847 Falls Ave, then stroll the scenic parkway, soaking in beautiful views of the American Falls, Bridal Veil Falls, and mighty Horseshoe Falls. Along the way, enjoy lively commentary about the local area. With your cruise entry included.
